disclosure: The US section currently has no published affiliate offer. If a reviewed merchant link is activated, it will be marked before the visitor leaves Select Your Sauna. A qualifying action may result in a commission without changing the merchant's price.

principles.title: Mark the outbound link
principles.copy: Affiliate attribution begins only when a visitor deliberately opens a clearly marked link. No tracking request is loaded in the background.

principles.title: Keep comparisons independent
principles.copy: Documented product facts, comparison scope and Finder logic are not ranked by commission. Paid placements and first-hand testing claims are not implied.

principles.title: Review the exact offer
principles.copy: A program, merchant, configuration, destination, tracking URL, freshness check and disclosure must pass review before a US affiliate link can be published.
